artifact: escalation ground-truth labels for the 29 golden TEST openers
purpose: Human judgement of whether each message may be auto-handled (a grounded draft reply published without human review) or must be escalated to a human agent. Consumed by scripts/evaluate_escalation.py to measure the Phase 6 policy (precision / recall / F1 / false-auto rate).

labeling_protocol.annotator: assignment author (single pass, before running the policy on this set)
labeling_protocol.input: message text only; golden intent labels were visible but NOT used as escalation labels
criteria: ESCALATE (money/account stakes): the issue involves purchases, refunds, payments, order delivery, warranty/repair pricing, or Apple ID/iCloud account access — wrong public advice could cause financial or account harm, or resolution needs private details.
ESCALATE (safety/off-topic): the message is abusive, violent, off-topic, or does not describe a technical issue — there is no groundable problem, and a casual auto-reply is a brand risk.
ESCALATE (ambiguity): the message is too vague or mixes many topics to safely answer with ONE public reply.

ESCALATE (unusable device / data at stake): the device is bricked/unusable or real-world data (tickets, work access) is at risk — wrong troubleshooting steps could destroy data; needs priority human help.

AUTO_OK: a single, clear technical software/hardware issue with standard troubleshooting evidence available — a grounded draft (with DM-redirect where the evidence style demands it) is safe to publish.
honesty_notes: Labels are a single human's judgement with fixed criteria, recorded once; no inter-annotator agreement exists (n=1 annotator).
The policy was designed from the rule semantics (taxonomy hints, Phase 3/4 threshold previews), then evaluated once on this labelled set — the numeric gates were NOT tuned on these labels.
n=29 is small: every rate below carries wide confidence intervals (reported by the evaluation script).

01.label: auto_ok
01.rationale: clear single software issue (App Store not working); standard troubleshooting evidence exists

02.label: auto_ok
02.rationale: clear software bug report (iOS 11.1 calendar); evidence-grounded reply is safe

04.label: auto_ok
04.rationale: clear software issue (Mail won't open after HighSierra upgrade)

05.label: escalate
05.rationale: repair PRICE QUOTE request — money stakes; prices must not be quoted from 2017 historical evidence and vary by region/plan (criteria: money/account stakes)

06.label: escalate
06.rationale: violent/off-topic content, no technical issue at all (criteria: safety/off-topic); a casual public auto-reply is a brand risk

07.label: auto_ok
07.rationale: clear software bug (I autocorrect), evidence covers it

08.label: auto_ok
08.rationale: bug complaint affecting some users; evidence-grounded troubleshooting reply is safe

09.label: auto_ok
09.rationale: vulgar but real hardware complaint (iPhone 7+ broke); safe reply asks what's going on / DM

10.label: escalate
10.rationale: off-topic rambling (follower thank-yous) with a vague complaint mixed in — no single groundable issue (criteria: ambiguity/off-topic)

13.label: auto_ok
13.rationale: clear software issue (battery drain after update); well-covered evidence

14.label: escalate
14.rationale: iPhone UNUSABLE after upgrade with real-world stakes (travel ticket to work, all communication) (criteria: unusable device / data at stake)

15.label: auto_ok
15.rationale: clear software bug (autocorrect I); strongest evidence case

16.label: auto_ok
16.rationale: battery dying at 90% — hardware-ish complaint, evidence covers battery diagnostics

17.label: escalate
17.rationale: reports a typo on Apple's own page — not a customer-device issue; a public auto-reply cannot resolve it and routing needs a human (criteria: off-topic/ambiguity)

18.label: escalate
18.rationale: asks for a support PHONE NUMBER — a specific fact that must not be quoted from stale historical evidence; support-process routing needs a human (criteria: money/account stakes analog: fact-risk + process routing)

19.label: auto_ok
19.rationale: clear software issue (update slowed phone, Spanish); evidence covers it

20.label: auto_ok
20.rationale: clear software issue (no iTunes access / podcast downloads after update)

21.label: auto_ok
21.rationale: rude but clear software complaint (battery after update)

22.label: escalate
22.rationale: MacBook Pro PAID FOR but not received + prior failed support contacts (criteria: money/account stakes; needs private order details)

23.label: escalate
23.rationale: phone reset itself and is now LOCKED — access recovery needed; wrong public advice (e.g. reset again) could lock out further; app streak loss suggests account coupling (criteria: money/account stakes + unusable device)

25.label: escalate
25.rationale: iCloud sign-in loop REJECTING a newly changed password, iPad unusable — account access where the correct step depends on private account state; public password advice can compound a lockout or miss a takeover (criteria: money/account stakes)

27.label: escalate
27.rationale: iPhone 6S boot-loop, phone UNUSABLE, urgent (criteria: unusable device / data at stake — wrong steps could force data loss)

28.label: auto_ok
28.rationale: ranting tone but a single clear technical issue (WiFi won't connect); evidence-grounded WiFi troubleshooting is safe

29.label: auto_ok
29.rationale: clear software issue (slow + crashing after update)
